SELECT INS_TIME , BIZ_CODE , SELLER_NAME_LOC , IRS_NO , PHONE_NO , EMAIL , CEO_NAME_LOC , JOB_DATE , IF_FLAG FROM BAT_UP_IMBUPR WHERE IF_FLAG IS NULL
